tools.name: search_open_calls
tools.description: Search open grants, tenders, fellowships and other funding calls. Returns facts and the official link, from the first 50 rows of a list.

tools.name: get_open_call
tools.description: Read the facts of one call by the id from search_open_calls, with its summary and official link.

tools.name: get_gondar_context
tools.description: What Gondar is, what this server can do, and what needs a free account. Call it first.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Read the signed-in workspace's applicant profile, which its fit scores are based on.

tools.name: list_my_matches
tools.description: List the open calls Gondar has matched to the signed-in workspace's profile, best fit first, with each call's score.

tools.name: list_saved_calls
tools.description: List the calls saved in the signed-in workspace.

tools.name: save_call
tools.description: Save a call to the signed-in workspace. It changes nothing else and applies for nothing.

tools.name: list_my_pipeline
tools.description: List the applications in the signed-in workspace's pipeline, with their stage and deadline.

tools.name: list_my_drafts
tools.description: List the application drafts in the signed-in workspace. Drafts need review before use.

tools.name: prepare_draft
tools.description: Step one of creating an application draft for a call. It spends nothing. It checks the plan and returns a confirmation token. Tell the user that one draft will be used from the monthly allowance, and call create_draft only after they agree.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Step two: generate an application draft for a call. It uses one draft from the monthly allowance, so call it only after the user agreed to what prepare_draft returned. It never applies: the user reviews the draft and applies at the official source.
